phrase.zh: 微小的差别，也可能指向新的发现。
phrase.en: A small difference can point to a new discovery.

visual.zh: 为瑞利独立创作的气体称量拼贴，以天平、玻璃容器和空白记录纸呼应气体密度研究。器材是象征性组合，不是他的原装实验设备；画面不提供气体读数或实验操作方法。
visual.en: An original gas-weighing collage for Rayleigh uses a balance, glass vessels and blank record paper to evoke gas-density research. Its apparatus is symbolic, not his original equipment, and provides no gas measurements or experimental procedure.

background.zh:
瑞利获得1904年诺贝尔物理学奖，表彰他对重要气体密度的研究，以及在这些研究中发现氩的贡献。配图用称量与比较的物件表现这一研究方向；透明容器中的颜色只来自器材和背景，不表示气体自身带有颜色。
1904年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他对重要气体密度的研究，以及在这些研究中发现氩的贡献。
background.en:
Rayleigh received the 1904 Nobel Prize in Physics for investigations of important gas densities and the discovery of argon associated with that work. The artwork interprets weighing and comparison; any color around the transparent vessels belongs to their materials or surroundings, not to the gas itself.
1904 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his investigations of the densities of the most important gases and for his discovery of argon in connection with these studies
